question: A sum of Rs. 4,620 is to be paid back in 2 equal annual instalments. How much is each instalment (in Rs.) if the interest is compounded annually at 10% per annum?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Rate of interest = 10% (per annum)

Fraction value = 10% = 1/10

∴ Principal = 10; Interest = 1

So, total installment = 10 + 1 = 11

 
 

 **Time Period**
 **Principal**
 
 
**Equal instalment **

 
**per annum**

 
 
 

 1st year
 10 × 11 = 110
 11 × 11 = 121
 
 

 2nd year
 10² = 100
 11² = 121
 
 

 
 
 
Total principal

 
= 110 + 100 = 210

 
 
 
 

 

So, 210 → Rs. 4620

∴ 121 → (4620/210) × 121 = Rs. 2662

∴ The each instalment (in Rs.) is Rs. 2662

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = Rs. 4620

Rate of interest = 10%

Total number of installment = 2

**Formula used:**

Installment = (P)/((frac{100){100+R} )+((100)/(100+R) )^n}

Where, P = Total amount; R = Rate of interest; n = Number of installment

**Calculation:**

Installment = (4620)/((frac{100){100+10} )+((100)/(100+10) )²}

= 4620/[(10/11) + (10/11)²]

= 4620/[(10/11) + (100/121)]

= 4620/(210/121)

= 4620 × (121/210)

= 2662

**∴ The each instalment (in Rs.) is Rs. 2662**
